lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Brainstorm five ideas for: stop worksheets blowing off an outdoor table. Star two that fit “scrap only”.

FEEDBACK
Ideas vary; stars must respect scrap-only.

WATCH FOR
Falling in love with the first idea without checking criteria wastes redesign time later.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Write brief + criteria + constraints. Brainstorm at least eight ideas. Choose one with a written property/reason match to criteria.

Write a short reflection naming one observation or step you corrected and why.

Parent: Likely misconception: Falling in love with the first idea without checking criteria wastes redesign time later. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Investigate or describe a fresh example (not the worked objects) that uses brief. Record evidence and explain how it supports your claim.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Name one science misconception about brief, correct it with evidence, and say why the correction works.

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Brief: keep desk cables tidy. Ideas: clips, box, tape spine, 3D-printed hook (if available). Choose clips from scrap card — meets cheap/fast constraints.

TRY FIRST
Brainstorm five ideas for: stop worksheets blowing off an outdoor table. Star two that fit “scrap only”.

FEEDBACK
Ideas vary; stars must respect scrap-only.
teach_steps.explain:
A design brief for the project states the user need and criteria. Brainstorming lists many ideas before choosing one that fits constraints.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner base claims on observation, fair tests and design evidence, rather than guessing from a picture alone. Keep every claim linked to what was seen or measured.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the observations, properties or test steps that carry the idea. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your record with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your evidence? If a result is uncertain, identify what would have to be observed or tested again. One deliberate, evidence-based revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: Falling in love with the first idea without checking criteria wastes redesign time later. Correct the claim or method, not just the neatness of the diagram.
